=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- scripts/gh_helpers.sh:1244 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: _autofix_pr_named_review_runs checks the workflow path and event but does NOT check that head_branch equals the default branch. Anyone who can push a branch can edit their copy of internal-review.yml and dispatch a workflow_dispatch run at that branch. The run will have path=.github/workflows/internal-review.yml and event=workflow_dispatch, so this helper matches it even though it did not run from the default branch.
  WHY: A spoofed dispatch from a non-default branch incorrectly appears as a peer run for autofix_retrigger_has_inflight_peer, suppressing legitimate re-dispatches, or incorrectly appears as consuming the changes-lost budget in autofix_changes_lost_head_retry_consumed.
- scripts/review_merge_train.sh:413 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[4]
  PROBLEM: _mt_inflight_review_branches emits pr:<N> keys for workflow_dispatch runs that have the correct display_title and event, but does not verify head_branch is the default branch. Same spoof vector as above, now affecting merge-train release: a forged PR-named active run keeps a queued PR from being released by the train.
  WHY: A forged dispatch run named for a queued PR prevents the merge train from releasing that PR.
- .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml:205-209 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=[3]
  PROBLEM: The dispatch_pr jq function matches by event==workflow_dispatch and exact display_title pattern, but the sweep fetches runs with workflow filters (internal-review.yml, review_autofix.yml) rather than the REST path-based identity. While the workflow name + event combo provides some filtering, a run dispatched on a non-default branch that still carries the internal-review.yml workflow path would match here and suppress the sweep for that PR.
  WHY: A forged dispatch from another branch prevents the sweep from dispatching review for the targeted PR.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The #5094 security finding (issue 5094) states "the poller trusts an unverified review run name" and the fix verifies identity and provenance for every PR-named match in the poller only. The completed plan explicitly documents residual same-pattern matchers outside scope: _autofix_pr_named_review_runs in gh_helpers.sh, _mt_inflight_review_branches in review_merge_train.sh, review_autofix_sweep.yml, and .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py.
  Expected change site: scripts/gh_helpers.sh _autofix_pr_named_review_runs, scripts/review_merge_train.sh _mt_inflight_review_branches, .github/workflows/review_autofix_sweep.yml dispatch_pr jq, .claude/scripts/check_in_status.py
  Evidence of absence: These sites match on display_title and event but do not verify head_branch equals the default branch, unlike _pr_named_review_dispatch_runs which was fixed under #5094. The #5094 completed plan Notes section states these are filed as follow-up #5152.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5

  WHY: A workflow file at a different location with the same basename could match.
